newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bourse opens 2.76 pct lower after election.
newsitem.headline: French bourse opens 2.76 pct lower after election.

text.p: The Paris bourse's blue chip index opened sharply lower on Monday after the left won Sunday's parliamentary election.
The CAC-40 index opened 2.76 percent lower at 2,512.62 points.
The CAC-40 June futures contract was down 73 points at 2,494.
The CAC index steadied above its lows in the first few minutes of trading then slipped to 2,507.38 at 0820 GMT.
Volume was a heavy one billion francs.

Although the market lost 6.5 percent last week on the left's first-round victory, share analysts predicted it would drop again on Monday on results showing that the Communists will hold the balance of power in a new government because the Socialists failed to win an outright majority of parliamentary seats.
Lagardere, down 7.6 percent, and Thomson-CSF, down 6.9 percent, were the top CAC losers as privatisation stocks were the hardest hit.
